card.timing: s8e is building the tier-1 replay arm now; deciding before it lands avoids rework.

evidence.text: A `null` `until` or gate `when` is never journaled. A re-entry therefore re-evaluates it even when it sits before a later journaled decision, and over re-executed tool output it can route differently there.
Only a decision whose route continues the walk is journaled. A `false` routed to a refusal and a `null` leave no row, so a refused activation re-verifies them on the next run

options.title: Keep: never journal a null

options.if_wrong: a re-entry can take a different route than the journal records, before a later journaled decision

options.title: Journal a null whose route continues the walk
options.summary: Same rule as false/true: journal when the walk continues; a null routed to a refusal stays unjournaled so a fixed tree still completes. New record superseding ADR-0174 d7 in part; flip the null test; small change in runtime::step.
options.holds_if: replay determinism matters more than re-verifying a null that let the walk continue
options.if_wrong: a null that should have been re-checked after a fix is replayed instead

options.title: Journal every null

options.holds_if: you want every routing decision on record
options.if_wrong: a refused-then-fixed re-run replays the stale null and cannot complete, contradicting D21-77's refusal rule
